promotion.rule: No spell bypasses testing, review, or promotion gates.

SCAN.description: Inspect code, state, logs, docs, or metadata without changing anything.

REFLECT.description: Explain or review a proposed change before any mutation.

CURE.description: Prepare a minimal targeted repair for a known defect.

ESUNA.description: Remove stale, invalid, deprecated, or unhealthy configuration while preserving behavior.

PROTECT.description: Add validation, guardrails, bounds, or safer defaults.

SHELL.description: Harden trust boundaries, secrets handling, permissions, or network exposure.

HASTE.description: Optimize an existing path without changing its public contract.

SLOW.description: Add throttling, backoff, debounce, or rate controls.

REGEN.description: Plan a repeatable health, retry, or self-recovery mechanism.

PHOENIX.description: Restore from a known checkpoint or revert a bounded failed mutation.

METEOR.description: Prepare a broad multi-file mutation plan. Never auto-apply.

ULTIMA.description: Prepare a final integration candidate or pull request plan. Never merge directly.
